Unified dual-tunnel routing, local UI API, and a fully editable preset tree.

- Replace the separate routing lists with one explicit rule editor supporting `direct`, `block`, strict awg1/awg2 chains, optional direct fallback, and an `enabled_presets` route override.
- Make enabled presets use the configured tunnel order strictly by default, without leaking to direct when every tunnel in the chain is unavailable.
- Add a versioned local `/api/v1` for status, settings, routing rules, verdicts and presets, with revisions and atomic route updates.
- Add custom root preset categories with localized alphabetical ordering; deleting a custom category safely moves its presets to Other.
- Save and load every routing rule, preset and custom category atomically in one `routing.json`; complete settings archives now contain the same document. Older multi-file routing archives are not supported.
- Improve tunnel health and probe diagnostics, open-connection migration after route changes, routing help, and the shared AI, Grok and Cursor presets.
